simple.meaning: שִׂיב (sîyb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “elder.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 5 times in Ezra, beginning at Ezra 5:5. The surrounding contexts include family line, commandment, kingship, prophetic witness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שִׂיב (H7868) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שִׂיב (sîyb) / H7868 is traced through Ezra 5:5, Ezra 5:9, Ezra 6:7, Ezra 6:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease, until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.

timeline.evidenceText: But the eye of their God was on the elders of the Jews, and they didn’t make them cease, until the matter should come to Darius, and an answer should be returned by letter concerning it.
Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”
Leave the work of this house of God alone; let the governor of the Jews and the elders of the Jews build this house of God in its place.

Moreover I make a decree what you shall do for these elders of the Jews for the building of this house of God: that of the king’s goods, even of the tribute beyond the River, expenses must be given with all diligence to these men, that they not be hindered.

The elders of the Jews built and prospered, through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo. They built and finished it, according to the commandment of the God of Israel, and according to the decree of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes king of Persia.
